usedFor: Lemon Squeezy holds orders and subscriptions, and each “Order Created” can land in Google Sheets with “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Subscription Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A new subscription updates a sheet row, so plan status stays in one place.

watchOut: “Order Created” is polling, so it reaches the sheet after a short delay, unlike “New Subscription Created”.
